import sys

def run(input: str) -> str:
    reversed_str = input[::-1]
    vowel_count = sum(1 for char in reversed_str if char.lower() in 'aeiou')
    return f'Reversed: {reversed_str}, Vowels: {vowel_count}'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(run(sys.stdin.read()))
